name: Lone Feather's Omen
description: Linnea's outfit. A custom-made costume for adventure that combines aesthetics with practicality. It even includes a small, portable cabin for Lumi (and any other friends who might visit in the future). The only problem is, there's just a single window to the outside world. Who gets the window seat is a matter that may call for some serious deliberation between Linnea and her friends.
